'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[2021 evacuation from Afghanistan]]
***[[Qatar Airways]] conducts the first evacuation flight from [[Kabul]]'s [[Hamid Karzai International Airport]] since the August 31 deadline. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2021/0909/1245534-taliban-us/ (RTÉ)] 
**[[2021 Afghan protests]]
***Former [[President of Afghanistan|president]] [[Hamid Karzai]] says in a series of tweets that the announcement of a caretaker [[government of Afghanistan|government]] by the Taliban was "necessary" and urges the Taliban to include women in the government in order to address "shortcomings of the new caretaker-announced cabinet". [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/afghanistan-news-live-updates-taliban-china-protest-anti-pakistan-isi-amrullah-saleh-nrf-panjshir-ahmad-massoud-1850788-2021-09-09 (''India Today'')]
*[[Tigray War]]
**The [[Tigray Defense Forces]] confirm their withdrawal from the [[Afar Region]], saying that they are re-deploying soldiers to the neighboring [[Amhara Region]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-ethiopia-conflict-idUSKBN2G50R8 (Reuters)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*On the 20th anniversary of his [[Ahmad Shah Massoud#Assassination|assassination]], the Taliban vandalizes the tombstone of [[Afghan mujahideen]] leader [[Ahmad Shah Massoud]]. The footage has sparked outrage among Afghans. [https://www.indiatoday.in/world/story/ahmad-shah-massoud-tombstone-vandalised-taliban-afghanistan-1850919-2021-09-09 (''India Today'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Royal Dutch Shell|Shell]] declares [[force majeure]] legal defense in order to forestall liabilities on some oil deliveries due to damage from [[Hurricane Ida]]. Damage discovered shortly after the storm to Shell's West Delta-143 shallow water platform, which serves as a hub for numerous offshore production pipelines, is still being assessed. The damage has caused significant issues with deliveries from the [[Mars (oil platform)|Mars]], [[Olympus tension leg platform|Olympus]], and Ursa platforms. [https://www.argusmedia.com/en/news/2252572-shell-declares-force-majeure-in-gulf-of-mexico?backToResults=true (Argus)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/shell-declares-force-majeure-some-oil-deliveries-after-hurricane-ida-2021-09-09/ (Reuters)]
*[[China]] releases its [[Strategic petroleum reserve (China)|strategic oil reserves]] for the first time in an effort "to ease the pressure of rising raw material prices", according to a statement from the [[National Food and Strategic Reserves Administration]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/9/9/china-sells-oil-reserves-to-lower-prices-in-unprecedented-move (Al Jazeera)]
*[[United States|American]] multinational financial services company [[Wells Fargo]] is fined [[United States dollar|$]]250 million for "unsafe or unsound practices" related to its [[Mortgage loan|home-lending]] practices by the United States [[Office of the Comptroller of the Currency]]. [https://www.charlotteobserver.com/news/business/banking/article254117948.html (''The Charlotte Observer'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*The [[Corps of the Port Captaincies – Coast Guard|Italian Coast Guard]] rescues 125 migrants stranded on an [[islet]] near [[Lampedusa]] after two of their boats partially sank. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/coast-guard-rescues-125-migrants-stranded-italian-isle-79916609 (AP via ABC News)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cambodia]]
****[[Cambodia]] surpasses 2,000 deaths from [[COVID-19]]. [https://www.khmertimeskh.com/50932342/higher-case-totals-again-as-cambodia-covid-deaths-pass-2000-mark/ (''Khmer Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The [[Japan]]ese [[Government of Japan|government]] announces the extension of its [[state of emergency]] in 19 [[Prefectures of Japan|prefecture]]s until September 30 with [[Miyagi Prefecture|Miyagi]] and [[Okayama Prefecture|Okayama]] prefectures being downgraded to a quasi-state of emergency after the expiry of their current orders on September 12. [https://www.asahi.com/sp/ajw/articles/14437035 (''The Asahi Shimbun'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines]]
****The [[Philippines]] reports a record 22,820 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 2,161,892. [https://www.rappler.com/nation/coronavirus-cases-philippines-september-9-2021 (Rappler)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports 450 new locally transmitted cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, which is the highest single-day total of new cases since August 2020. [https://www.straitstimes.com/singapore/health/450-new-locally-transmitted-covid-19-cases-in-spore-unvaccinated-62-year-old-man (''The Straits Times'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****The [[Scottish Parliament]] approves a requirement for people who want to attend nightclubs and large events to show an [[immunity passport]] declaring that they have been fully [[COVID-19 vaccination|vaccinated]] against COVID-19, despite opposition from businesses leaders and opposition parties. The requirement will take effect on October 1. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2021/sep/09/scottish-parliament-approves-plans-for-vaccine-passports (''The Guardian'')]
****[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United Kingdom]]
*****The [[Medicines and Healthcare Products Regulatory Agency]] approves booster doses of the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] and [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|AstraZeneca]] vaccines. [https://www.bbc.com/news/health-58499863 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]], [[COVID-19 vaccination in Italy]]
****The [[Italian Medicines Agency]] approves the administration of a third dose of the [[COVID-19 vaccine]] to clinically vulnerable people using the [[MRNA]]-based [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] and [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] vaccines. [https://www.ansa.it/english/newswire/english_service/2021/09/09/covid-19-medicines-agency-aifa-oks-3rd-vaccine-dose-3_783275c0-f7b8-450e-9afa-ee4cc1015612.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Turkey]]
****The number of [[COVID-19 vaccine]] doses [[COVID-19 vaccination in Turkey|administered]] in [[Turkey]] surpasses 100 million. [https://www.dailysabah.com/turkey/turkey-surpasses-100-million-doses-of-covid-19-jabs-administered/news (''Daily Sabah'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 vaccination in the United States]]
****[[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]] announces new wide-ranging requirements for federal employees and employees of companies with more than 100 workers to receive the COVID-19 vaccine or undergo regular [[COVID-19 testing|testing]] at least once a week, with no option of testing for unvaccinated federal employees. These mandates apply to over 100 million people, which represents two-thirds of all U.S. employees. [https://apnews.com/article/joe-biden-business-health-coronavirus-pandemic-executive-branch-18fb12993f05be13bf760946a6fb89be (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in California]]
****The [[Los Angeles Unified School District]] approves a vaccine mandate for children over the age of 12 in [[Los Angeles]] schools. [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/los-angeles-schools-covid-vaccine-mandate-passes/ (CBS News)]
*[[France|French]] [[Minister of Health (France)|health minister]] [[Olivier Veran]] announces that the country will offer free [[birth control]] to all women under the age of 25, which will also include free contraception-related medical visits, starting in 2022. This measure will cost the [[Government of France|government]] about 21 million euros ([[United States dollar|US$]]24,828,552) per year. [https://www.npr.org/2021/09/09/1035458635/france-free-birth-control (AP via NPR)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Belarus–Russia relations]]
**[[Russia|Russian]] [[President of Russia|president]] [[Vladimir Putin]] and [[Belarus|Belarusian]] [[President of Belarus|president]] [[Alexander Lukashenko]] agree to multiple terms that will bring the two nations' economies closer together. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/sep/09/putin-and-lukashenko-discuss-integrating-russia-and-belarus (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Moroccan general election]]
**Preliminary results show the [[National Rally of Independents]] party led by [[Aziz Akhannouch]] winning a plurality in the [[House of Representatives (Morocco)|House of Representatives]], defeating the ruling [[Justice and Development Party (Morocco)|Justice and Development Party]] of [[Prime Minister of Morocco|Prime Minister]] [[Saadeddine Othmani]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/sep/09/islamists-suffer-losses-as-liberal-parties-gain-ground-in-morocco-elections (''The Guardian'')]
*[[United States Attorney General|U.S. Attorney General]] [[Merrick Garland]] announces that the [[United States Department of Justice|Justice Department]] has sued the state of [[Texas]] over its new [[Texas Heartbeat Act|abortion law]], asking a federal judge to declare the law invalid, in order "to enjoin its enforcement, and to protect the rights that Texas has violated". [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/justice-dept-sues-texas-states-abortion-law-79923727 (AP via ABC News)]
